Happy Birthday, My Sunshine ❤️

I don't think there's a version of my life anymore that doesn't have you in it, and I'm so grateful for that. You've given me a kind of steady, easy happiness I didn't know I was missing — and I get to wake up and love you a little more every single day.

So today, I hope you feel exactly how loved you are. I hope you're surrounded by peace, and good laughter, and moments worth keeping. You deserve every good thing that's coming your way, and I mean that with my whole heart.

And please — no tears about turning 25. This isn't an ending of anything. It's the start of some of the best years you're going to live, and I get a front-row seat to watch you become even more of who you already are. I'm so proud of that woman, by the way.

I hope that when you look back on this birthday one day, you remember exactly how loved you were. Because I plan on making a lot more memories with you after this one.

25 looks beautiful on you already. ❤️
